info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-List Airline Flights Baggages-v3-spec
info.description: The Airline Flight Baggage Listing API provides a comprehensive view of baggage associated with airline flights, helping users to track and manage their luggage. This API allows developers to retrieve detailed information about checked baggage for specific flights, including baggage status and other relevant data. Airlines, travel agencies, and customer service platforms can leverage this API to enhance passenger experience by providing timely updates and information about baggage handling. Use cases include flight-related inquiries and improving operational transparency in airline services.

get.description: Fetches detailed baggage details associated with specific flights. Use this endpoint to check the status, weight limits, and any additional baggage policies in place for your flights.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve information about the baggage policies and allowances associated with specific flights. It allows the client to specify details such as flight number, origin, and destination, which will help in fetching the correct baggage information.

ListAirlineFlightsBaggagesRequest.description: A request body representing the baggage information for flight operations using the GET method.
